name: Whales Wrapped in Starlight
description: The Milky Way forms the shape of a giant whale, with smaller star-constellation whales swimming through the night.
prompt: A night sky where the Milky Way forms the shape of a giant whale, smaller whales made of stars swimming through constellations, deep blue and silver, quiet cosmic scale, cinematic, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: Look up: maybe the stars are just old sea creatures resting. What night sky would you swim through?
